title: Premium family purchased not working
body:
Good app overall, loved it and still using. I have purchased the family premium subscription but its not working. Could not add other people to use the premium service, because its not displaying on iCloud subscriptions. I guess because it was one time forever purchase, not counting as subscription. Even so, this is bug yet to be considered by developers. Please, give some attention to this moment. I hope you will fix and help us enjoy your app even more. 

P.S. I’m writing this review so devs will see it, because inside the app support chat, I didn’t get the help from Dave.
